definitions.x: root pivot and +x the chosen macro literal; the -x case is symmetric
definitions.GenPlus_x(r): set of positive x-parent clauses P for which some negative x-parent N resolves with P to the non-tautological resolvent r
definitions.I_x(r): intersection over P in GenPlus_x(r) of the signed co-literals P\{+x}
definitions.E_xb: sum (1+|r|) over unique resolvents r not in R0 with b in I_x(r)
definitions.Y_xb: unique star-overhead clause set Comp(A_b) union BridgeC_b union BridgeN_b union {(-e,-b)}
definitions.U_x: exact pre-subsumption raw units of eliminating x from F

lemma.statement: For a unique non-tautological x-resolvent r not already retained, r belongs to Res(A_b,N)\(R0 union Res(C_b,N)) if and only if b belongs to every positive generator of r, equivalently b in I_x(r).
proof: Membership in Res(A_b,N) means r has at least one positive generator containing b.
Nonmembership in Res(C_b,N) means r has no positive generator lacking b.
Together these are exactly the statement that every positive generator contains b; since at least one generator exists, b belongs to their intersection I_x(r).
The explicit exclusion r not in R0 handles retained-clause duplication exactly.

exact_relief_corollary.statement: Because e is fresh, every clause in Y_xb contains e or -e while B=R0 union Res(C_b,N) contains no e. Hence Y_xb is disjoint from B. The rectangle-to-star identity therefore simplifies exactly to J(F,x,b)=E_xb-H_xb.

exact_rescue_score.statement: If the macro CNF itself fits the frozen state cap, then rho_xb = N^2-U_raw(M_xb(F),x). Therefore rho_xb>=0 is an exact sufficient-and-necessary raw-cap test for elimination of x after this fixed pivot-involving macro, before the independent progress/macro-verification gates.

universal_candidate.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-ordinary-pivot-overflow state contains some root pivot x, polarity sign, and co-literal b such that the corresponding verified v2 macro fits its macro cap and rho_{sign(x),b}>=0.
universal_candidate.consequence_if_proved: L1 root-phase grammar totality follows from a polynomially enumerable subset of v2 consisting only of pivot-involving literal pairs.
